### About and links
Settings › About now links to the Patchy UI project on GitHub and to its author, Joshua Omilian.
Still made for **Patchy 1.2.1**.

### A maintenance release
Nothing changes in how Patchy UI works. This release confirms that updates arrive and install correctly, and tidies up how releases are built.
Still made for **Patchy 1.2.1**.

### The first release of Patchy UI
Patchy UI puts a window and a menu bar item on top of Patchy, so you can host websites on your Mac without opening Terminal.
- See every site and its health at a glance - Add a site, remove it, or point it at a different folder - Group related sites, such as one customer's domain and subdomains - Start, stop and restart the server - Follow each site's error and visit logs live - Switch PHP version and refresh certificates - Set up password-free mode once, with your Mac password
This version is made for **Patchy 1.2.1**. Patchy UI's version number always matches the Patchy release it supports.
